225				continue

213	func (d *EmailDispatcher) listMemosByID(ctx context.Context, memoIDs []int32) (map[int32]*store.Memo, error) {
214		if len(memoIDs) == 0 {
215			return map[int32]*store.Memo{}, nil
216		}
217	
218		uniqueMemoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoIDs))
219		seenMemoIDs := make(map[int32]struct{}, len(memoIDs))
220		for _, memoID := range memoIDs {
221			if memoID == 0 {
222				continue
223			}
224			if _, seen := seenMemoIDs[memoID]; seen {
225				continue
226			}
227			seenMemoIDs[memoID] = struct{}{}
228			uniqueMemoIDs = append(uniqueMemoIDs, memoID)
229		}
230		if len(uniqueMemoIDs) == 0 {
231			return map[int32]*store.Memo{}, nil
232		}
233	
234		memos, err := d.store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{IDList: uniqueMemoIDs})
235		if err != nil {
236			return nil, err
237		}
238	
239		memosByID := make(map[int32]*store.Memo, len(memos))
240		for _, memo := range memos {
241			memosByID[memo.ID] = memo
242		}
243		return memosByID, nil
244	}

246	func collectInboxMemoIDs(inboxes []*store.Inbox) []int32 {

251			}
252			switch inbox.Message.Type {
253			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT:
254				payload := inbox.Message.GetMemoComment()
255				if payload != nil {

262				}
263			default:
264				// Ignore notification types without memo references.
265			}
266		}
267		return memoIDs
